_comment: Curated Zephyr conventions researched 2026-07-28 from docs.zephyrproject.org (latest). Facts about the user's install come only from the workspace; this pack is how-Zephyr-works knowledge.

building-apps.title: Building Zephyr applications
building-apps.summary: Apps need CMakeLists.txt (find_package(Zephyr) before project()), prj.conf, and src/main.c; build with west build -b <board> from or pointing at the app directory.

app-locations.title: Where applications live
app-locations.summary: User applications belong inside the west workspace beside zephyr/, conventionally <workspace>/applications/<app>; RITA scaffolds there (applications_dir config).

west-commands.title: west build / flash conventions
west-commands.summary: west build -b <board/soc/variant> [-d dir] [-p]; -t run for emulators; CMake args after --; west flash [--runner jlink] rebuilds by default.

twister.title: Twister, the test gate
twister.summary: west twister -T <suite> -p <platform>; device runs need --device-testing --hardware-map (generated, never hardcoded); twister.json in the outdir is the machine-readable verdict.

ztest.title: ztest test authoring
ztest.summary: ZTEST_SUITE + ZTEST macros with zassert_* assertions; CONFIG_ZTEST=y in prj.conf; a testcase.yaml registers the suite so twister runs it.

devicetree-overlays.title: Devicetree overlays
devicetree-overlays.summary: Overlays (boards/<BOARD>.overlay or app.overlay, discovered in a fixed order) enable peripherals and add bus devices; the merged result is build/zephyr/zephyr.dts.

mspi.title: MSPI multi-bit SPI bus
mspi.summary: MSPI drives single-to-hex-wide SDR/DDR devices (mspi_dev_config, mspi_transceive, XIP via CONFIG_MSPI_MEMMAP); in-tree samples under samples/drivers/mspi/ (async, flash, timing_scan, throughput).

psram.title: PSRAM over MSPI
psram.summary: PSRAM attaches as an MSPI device driven by a memc driver (e.g. memc_mspi_aps6404l); overlay sets mspi-io-mode (quad/octal/hex) and frequency, prj.conf enables CONFIG_MSPI + memc + MEMMAP for XIP.

flash-and-debug.title: Flashing and debugging
flash-and-debug.summary: west flash --runner <tool> for one board; batch device work goes through twister's generated hardware map; RTT/stateful serial belongs to the pytest harness.

function-contracts.title: Function parameter contracts
function-contracts.summary: Every function restricts or validates its input/output parameters before executing: enums/narrow types, guard clauses, error returns; unit tests exercise the contract per function.

unity-testing.title: Unity host unit tests
unity-testing.summary: Host-run Unity tests (not ztest): one function in isolation, hardware stubbed, test_<function> naming so per-function coverage is mechanically checkable.

sdk.title: The Zephyr SDK
sdk.summary: Toolchains live in zephyr-sdk-<version> dirs (HOME, /opt, %PROGRAMFILES%); discovery: ZEPHYR_SDK_INSTALL_DIR, CMake registry, standard paths; sdk_version file names the exact version.
